items.title: Pay heating maintenance invoice
items.quote: Den Rechnungsbetrag erbitten wir ohne Abzug binnen 10 Tagen ab Rechnungsdatum auf das unten genannte Konto.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 25.11.2026 (Wednesday). The period is 'binnen 10 Tagen ab Rechnungsdatum', a civil-law period triggered by an event, so under Section 187(1) BGB the day of the event (25.11.) is not counted; counting starts 26.11.2026. Counting 10 days: 26,27,28,29,30 Nov + 1,2,3,4,5 Dec = the 10th day is Saturday, 05.12.2026. Since this falls on a Saturday, Section 193 BGB shifts the deadline to the next working day. No public holiday intervenes in NRW between 05.12. and 07.12.2026, so the due date becomes Monday, 07.12.2026.
